ns2:section.sectionText: Topic: Multi-scale modeling of materials. The rapid advancement of computational capabilities has led to the discovery of new fundamental mechanics principles at the nanoscale, which are guiding the use of nanotechnology and nanomaterials in next generation aerospace applications. This course will introduce the theoretical foundation of multi-scale modeling methods, and will provide students with hands-on modeling and simulation experience at the quantum-mechanical, molecular, and the continuum scales. Particular emphasis will be placed on newly developed bridging techniques, such as inverse solution approaches, to interpret material phenomena across the different size-scales.
